overall_summary: Family emotional and universal relationship shorts (Maa, Papa, Bhai, calling loved ones) significantly outperform the niche romantic/digital 'self respect' tech-detox updates (like deleting contacts or muting chats), which pulled very low views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Maa (215 views), Papa (132 views), Bhai (96 views), and calling loved ones (278 views) generated far higher organic traction compared to digital breakup/self-respect niches.
winning_patterns.action: Pivot the core focus of the channel slightly toward broader emotional family and human connection themes rather than repetitive smartphone-based breakups.

weak_patterns.evidence: Shorts revolving around deleting chats, changing wallpapers, or removing contacts (e.g., cuKSS0gHyt0, hT4EGP69mRw) consistently flatlined at 0-4 views.
weak_patterns.action: Stop overusing the specific smartphone settings/widgets removal format and introduce physical, real-world emotional settings.
